name: petasats-mcp

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Read-only live USDC on Base to BSV quote. Amount is USDC atomic units; returns price and costs.

from_asset.description: Asset to convert FROM: USDC or BSV (phase 1 supports USDC → BSV only)

to_asset.description: Asset to convert TO: USDC or BSV (phase 1 supports USDC → BSV only)

amount_in.description: Amount of from_asset in atomic units, as a decimal string (e.g. USDC 6dp: "1000000" = 1 USDC; BSV in sats).

tools.name: swap_asset_to_bsv
tools.description: Starts a funds-moving USDC on Base to BSV swap. Amounts are atomic strings; returns the local swap id.

from_asset.description: Asset to convert into BSV: USDC or BSV (phase 1 supports USDC → BSV only) (not BSV itself)

amount_in.description: Amount of from_asset in atomic units (decimal string).

deliver_to.description: Optional destination BSV address. Confirmed BSV is swept there automatically.

min_bsv_out.description: Optional minimum BSV output in sats.

quote.description: Optional: a quote object returned by get_quote, to lock its terms (bound to route + pair + amount_in).

tools.name: wait_for_swap
tools.description: Read-only wait for a local swap stage change, for up to 55 seconds.

tools.name: swap_status
tools.description: Read-only structured local swap status and transaction links.

tools.name: wallet_info
tools.description: Read-only local Base and BSV addresses and balances; no key material.

tools.name: withdraw_bsv
tools.description: Moves all confirmed BSV from this kit to the supplied BSV address.

tools.name: withdraw_base
tools.description: Moves USDC or ETH from the local Base wallet. Amount is atomic or all.

tools.name: fund_wallet
tools.description: Read-only USDC on Base to BSV funding plan and quote; does not move funds.

from_asset.description: Source asset to spend (default USDC): USDC or BSV (phase 1 supports USDC → BSV only)

amount_in.description: Amount of from_asset to spend, atomic units (decimal string).

tools.name: list_liquidity
tools.description: Read-only supported USDC on Base to BSV service information.

asset.description: Optional filter: only pairs involving this asset (USDC or BSV (phase 1 supports USDC → BSV only)).

instructions:
PetaSats buyer kit. It buys BSV with USDC on Base through a cross-chain atomic swap with the PetaSats market maker. It runs on this computer and keeps its keys here; no service ever holds the user's funds.

SCOPE: USDC on Base -> BSV only. About $5 to $100 per swap. Each buyer: at most 3 swaps and $200 per day. A shared daily total can make the service busy; a declined request can be retried later.

UNITS: amounts are decimal strings in the smallest unit. USDC has 6 decimals ("25000000" = 25 USDC). BSV is in satoshis ("100000000" = 1 BSV). ETH is in wei.

STEPS
1. wallet_info. The kit needs USDC and a little ETH (for gas) on Base at its own base_address. If it has none, tell the user that address and what to send. Never move the user's funds from another wallet unless they ask.
2. get_quote. It shows the exact BSV for an exact USDC amount, the rate and the costs. A quote lasts about 60 seconds.
3. If a person is directing you, show them the quote and get a clear yes. This is the only time to ask. If they already gave you an amount and a limit, that is the yes.
4. swap_asset_to_bsv with quote_id (or min_bsv_out). If the quote has expired, the kit gets a new one and goes ahead only if it pays at least min_bsv_out, or 99% of the old quote.
5. wait_for_swap until done is true (each call waits up to about 50 seconds). A swap usually takes 15 to 25 minutes, mostly waiting for one BSV block.
6. Results: delivered or settled = BSV received; refunded = the USDC came back to the kit; failed = nothing was locked.

REPORTING
- A person is watching: give one short line only when the stage changes, then a final summary with the amounts, the txids and their links.
- Called by a program or another agent: return only the final result or the error.
- Never pause, slow down or ask anything once a swap has started. Reporting never holds up the swap.

SAFETY
- Keep this MCP server running until the swap is done. If it stops, the swap resumes safely when it starts again. If it stays stopped for more than about 3 hours after the USDC lock, the swap cannot finish; the kit then refunds the USDC the next time it runs after the Base timelock ends (about 16 hours after the lock).
- The kit refuses a new swap or a withdrawal while a swap is in progress.
- withdraw_bsv and withdraw_base send funds out of the kit. Use only an address the user gave you, and confirm it with them.
- Never open, print or send the kit's keys file. Tell the user to keep a backup of it: it holds the only copy of the kit's keys.
